EDGE_INGRESS_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for authenticating with your queue platform API. You will receive this from your queue platform dashboard.

JWT_SECRET.description: Random secret used to sign bypass cookies. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

RULES_KV.description: KV namespace used to cache ACL rules per domain. A new namespace will be created automatically.

QUEUE_DOMAIN.description: Domain where your queue service is hosted. Queue nodes are resolved as `https://your_company.virtual-queue.com`.
